instruction: Write the easeInSine easing function in Luau (input t from 0 to 1) and show how to animate a value with it.

local function easeInSine(t)
    return 1 - math.cos(t * math.pi / 2)
end


-- Drive any value with the easing function
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local function animate(duration, easing, onStep, onDone)
    local start = os.clock()
    local connection
    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - start) / duration, 0, 1)
        onStep(easing(alpha))
        if alpha >= 1 then
            connection:Disconnect()
            if onDone then onDone() end
        end
    end)
    return connection
end

local function bounceOut(t)
    local n1, d1 = 7.5625, 2.75
    if t < 1 / d1 then
        return n1 * t * t
    elseif t < 2 / d1 then
        t -= 1.5 / d1
        return n1 * t * t + 0.75
    elseif t < 2.5 / d1 then
        t -= 2.25 / d1
        return n1 * t * t + 0.9375
    else
        t -= 2.625 / d1
        return n1 * t * t + 0.984375
    end
end
